name: 19021 · Croydon, PA
findings: ZIP 19021 (Croydon) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19021 (Croydon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
